title: Enhanced Conditions Expert

guide.name: Enhanced Conditions Expert
guide.role: Encompass Enhanced Conditions migration and API specialist for DevConnect Labs

overview: Enhanced Conditions (Encompass 20.2+) replace flat standard/eFolder conditions with a tiered model: condition types own shared vocabularies; condition templates reference a type.

Access is role-based: rights are granted to Encompass roles (GET /encompass/v3/settings/roles), not to individual user accounts and not as a per-condition ACL like the legacy ConditionsTemplate.xml CDO.

DevConnect Labs Condition Manager converts the legacy ConditionsTemplate.xml Custom Data Object into dry-run Enhanced Conditions payloads. Live create/read/update/delete against ICE APIs is on the Enhanced Conditions pages (Live CRUD console) via /api/encompass-conditions.

concepts.name: Condition type
concepts.summary: Owns option vocabularies: categoryDefinitions, recipientDefinitions, sourceDefinitions, priorToDefinitions, trackingDefinitions. Create types before templates.

concepts.name: Condition template
concepts.summary: Reusable condition definition that references a conditionType. Carries title, internalId, descriptions, category, source, priorTo, recipient, printDefinitions, optional externalId/externalDescription.

concepts.name: Condition set
concepts.summary: Grouping of templates used when applying conditions to loans.

concepts.name: Loan enhanced conditions
concepts.summary: Instances of templates/conditions on a loan file. Managed with /encompass/v3/loans/{loanId}/conditions. Loan flag ENHANCEDCOND.X1 / useEnhancedConditionIndicator selects Enhanced vs Standard.

concepts.name: Role access
concepts.summary: Who can Add, edit details, comments, and set statuses (Opened, Fulfilled, Re-requested, Received, Not-Fulfilled, Deactivated, Waived). Granted by role, not per template row.

concepts.name: Roles vs personas vs users
concepts.summary: Legacy CDO ConditionAccess lists are Encompass role names (matched on roleName or roleAbbr). Roles carry the personas and user groups attached to them; users inherit through their role. Do not import users or personas for this migration.

migration.source: Legacy ConditionsTemplate.xml Custom Data Object (GET settings CDO / Postman Save Response as { name, dataObject }).
outputs: condition-types.json — one type per stage (Pre-Purchase, Post-Purchase in the AmeriHome CDO)
condition-templates.json — one template per legacy condition; internalId = legacy code
acl-profiles.json — collapsed role permission patterns for admin handoff
migration.iceAdminTool: Encompass Admin Tools > Enhanced Conditions Tool: Convert Standard to Enhanced Conditions, or Migrate Enhanced Conditions between instances. Converted conditions stay inactive until an admin activates them. Prerequisites: condition types (matching Category/Prior To/Source/Recipient), documents, matching roles, Enable Enhanced Conditions.
rules: Dry-run conversion stays in Condition Manager / convert until an admin uses Live CRUD or Postman. Live writes go through /api/encompass-conditions (catalog + invoke + REST) on the Enhanced Conditions pages.
Create condition types first, then templates.
Apply ACL profiles by role; Enhanced Conditions has no per-condition ACL.
Reconcile CDO role names against GET /encompass/v3/settings/roles (name or abbreviation). Only a Production role list is authoritative; UAT is provisional.
The legacy CDO stored role names in a 20-character field; truncated or merged names need a human decision.

settings.title: Create condition types
settings.notes: Body is a JSON array of { title, definitions: { categoryDefinitions, recipientDefinitions, sourceDefinitions, priorToDefinitions, trackingDefinitions } }.

settings.title: Create condition templates
settings.notes: Body array fields include title, conditionType, internalId (alphanumeric), internalDescription, category, source, priorTo, recipient, printDefinitions (InternalPrint|ExternalPrint), optional externalId/externalDescription. Types must exist first.

postman.collectionHint: ICE Postman collection folder: Encompass Loan > Enhanced Conditions > Enhanced Condition Settings (and Manage Enhanced Conditions for loan-level).
safeOrder: 3. PATCH create types from handoff condition-types.json (UAT first)
5. PATCH create a small smoke batch of templates (not all 826 at once)
7. Configure role-based Enhanced Conditions rights from acl-profiles.json

faqs.a: No. Import/create condition types and templates. Configure access by role. Users already exist and inherit rights through their role.

No bulk import. Reconcile the role names referenced by the legacy ACL lists against GET /encompass/v3/settings/roles, create any missing roles in admin, then grant Enhanced Conditions rights to those roles.

faqs.q: What is the admin handoff pack?
faqs.a: Dry-run JSON under data/encompass-conditions/handoff/: condition-types.json, condition-templates.json, acl-profiles.json, plus the data-quality report. Admins can apply these with the Live CRUD console (UAT first) or Postman. Condition Manager itself does not auto-push.
Types first. Templates reference conditionType titles that must already exist.
No. ICE's conversion tool and our dry-run both leave activation as an admin step (Enable Enhanced Conditions / activate types/templates).
